The Hundred Days and the New Deal

THIS WEEK

This week covers Franklin Roosevelt's first months in office, the programs of the New Deal, and the debates over how far the national government should go.

Take the pages in this order: the lesson "The Hundred Days," then the source Franklin D. Roosevelt, First Inaugural Address, then the lesson "Experiment, Critics, and the States," and then the source Franklin D. Roosevelt, First Fireside Chat. Read each lesson before the source that follows it, since the lessons give you the background you need to read the sources well.

What to turn in: this week's main assignment is a Primary Source Report. You will also take part in the discussion "The New Deal: Emergency Measure or New Constitutional Order?" Instructions, due dates, and links for both are in Canvas.

When you finish, open the Week Wrap-Up page and use its checklist to confirm that everything is submitted.
